supersedes: name-p0-preregistration-amendment-1.json (approved parts only; the rest of amendment 1 stays proposed)
status: Decision principles conditionally approved by the user. NOT a fully frozen training preregistration: checkpoint selection is verified below but no training grid is registered. Training experiments remain on hold.

decision_rules.primary_metric: Per source and per protection policy exact-span F1 (TP/FP/FN, precision, recall always reported). No pooled average offsets a source.
decision_rules.improvement_target: Each candidate must name its source x policy target(s) before running. The best-improving item after the fact is never promoted to primary.
decision_rules.training_seeds: Learned candidates: all three pre-registered seeds (20261010, 20261011, 20261012) must individually pass every regression and improvement condition. Mean/SD/min reported; no best-seed selection. Not required for projections of identical predictions (no training).
decision_rules.regressions: Three per-span regressions at zero tolerance (lost exact spans, new false-positive spans, newly exposed previously-masked names); unit = span per sentence; no offsetting by other gains.
decision_rules.improvement_criterion: Delta F1 = candidate - baseline; the lower bound of the two-sided 95% percentile interval must be > 0.
decision_rules.ties_and_uncertainty: Not adopted. No post-hoc change of criteria, thresholds, seeds or evaluation scope after seeing the same evaluation result.

bootstrap.type: paired, same resampled indices for baseline and candidate
bootstrap.statistic: pooled TP/FP/FN summed over resampled units, then F1 and Delta F1; not a mean of per-document F1
bootstrap.resample_unit: document (sentence record); KDPII records are grouped by the conversation prefix before the first underscore of the ID when that prefix groups >1 record (assumption: ID structure 'DataN.M_a_b'; group counts are reported)
bootstrap.note: Bootstrap seed is unrelated to the training seeds.

checkpoint_selection.formula: Maximize the tuple (mean exact F1 over validation sources, -sum of FP over those sources, threshold, -epoch), compared lexicographically; higher threshold then earlier epoch break ties.
checkpoint_selection.validation_sources: KLUE validation NSMC, KLUE validation Wikitree, KDPII validation (equal macro weights); synthetic validation is reporting only.
checkpoint_selection.thresholds_and_epochs: Grid and EPOCHS=3 are defined in that script; any candidate trainer must pin its own grid in its own amendment.
checkpoint_selection.role_separation: Validation sets select checkpoints only. Development comparison sets (ledger) judge candidates. A set used for both purposes is reported as development/selection, never as generalization.
checkpoint_selection.status: Applies only to trainers that reuse this selection. A different trainer needs its selection formula pinned in a new amendment before training starts.

product_requirement.statement: The protected scope includes real names AND nicknames, stage names, and user names/handles that identify an individual account. Protection does not require a verified link to a real name. Ordinary words, project code names, organization or shared accounts are not detected merely because they look like names.
product_requirement.paired_contexts: Same surface string in a personal-reference context and a non-personal context must be judged differently; see handle_scope_experiment.
product_requirement.scope_vs_adoption: Accepting the scope is separate from adopting an implementation. personal_handle is not merged into KR_NAME or any API/metric meaning changed. If the experiment fails, record 'nickname protection requirement unmet'; the requirement is not narrowed to keep scores.

gpu_baseline.dtype: float32 weights and inputs; autocast OFF; TF32 OFF (matmul and cudnn); torch.set_float32_matmul_precision('highest')
gpu_baseline.inference: Same pinned E5 revision a308c54b, threshold 0.9, 512-token windows, stride 64, batch size 4, same frozen document-ID sets (999/1992 etc.).
gpu_baseline.rule: CPU baseline is preserved and never replaced; candidates compare only with the GPU baseline of identical device/dtype/library settings.

handle_scope_experiment.status: approved single-factor contrast; no training, no threshold/particle/dictionary change

arms.B: A plus personal_handle spans, projected from the SAME raw model output

handle_scope_experiment.implementation_note: Both arms are projected from one raw KoreanNER pass with personal_handle decoded as a separate experimental entity. A is verified to equal the unpatched raw KR_NAME output before use. src/ is not modified.
handle_scope_experiment.declared_targets: KDPII test 500 and KDPII fresh 1992 under policy PS_NAME+PS_NICKNAME: recall and F1 (primary metric F1).
handle_scope_experiment.fixed_gold: Both arms are scored against the same gold within each policy. PS_NAME+PS_NICKNAME is the nickname-aware gold; PS_NAME-only gold is used to report regressions on real names and spans added by B that are not real names.
handle_scope_experiment.unannotated_sets: KLUE and synthetic have no nickname gold: B-added spans there are counted and reported as unannotated handle-type spans, not scored as true or false positives; nickname F1 is not claimed for them.

paired_context_set.note: Fixed before any model output on these sentences; reserve KLUE/KDPII not used.

acceptance_for_scope_check: Delta F1 lower bound > 0 on both KDPII sets (PS_NAME+PS_NICKNAME)
zero lost exact spans and zero new spans on real-name gold beyond B-added handle spans (reported individually)
zero non_personal paired contexts newly flagged by B relative to A
all counts, including residual misses after the expansion, are reported separately from the scope effect
handle_scope_experiment.interpretation: Result is the effect of widening the output scope of the same model, not a learned improvement.
